exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "During the period of".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
Noun の 間に (〜no aida ni)
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Noun の 間に (〜no aida ni) matches "During the period of".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Noun の 間に (〜no aida ni).
exercises.explanation: Expresses an action happening during a specific period marked by a noun.
